title: Esc menu
note: The menu over the running game (no pause): Esc (ui_cancel) opens and closes it; the game runs on, the mouse is free while it is open and captured again on close. While it is open the own character takes no gameplay input (it stands still: no move, look, sprint, jump, interact or item use; those keys go to the menu or nowhere); the voice keeps working as set (voice activation, or the Talk key while held). The page shows one frame per tab and case; the focused control is drawn in every state that has one.

states.label: Лобі: хост
states.note: In the lobby, the host's view (the Esc menu opens on Lobby there): presets, the settings the host edits live, the room code with Copy, a full lobby of 10 players (the list scrolls) and Ready. Role is hidden in the lobby.

states.label: Лобі: гравець
states.note: A player's view of the same tab, and everyone's in a round (settings change only in the lobby): values without steppers, tasks as static chips, the host's name by a lock. This player joined with the code, so the code row shows.

states.label: Лобі: без коду
states.note: The host's view when the code service closed or was never reachable: one line in place of the code row.

states.label: Персонаж
states.note: In the lobby: the name and the body colour apply live.

states.label: Персонаж у раунді
states.note: In a round: locked; the name is read-only and the swatches take no input.

states.label: Гра: хост
states.note: In a round (the menu opens on Game there), the host: Leave and Quit open the confirm dialog.

states.label: Гра: гравець
states.note: In a round, a player: Leave and Quit act at once.

states.label: Гра: підтвердження
states.note: The host pressed Leave: the confirm dialog (P1) over the menu. Quit opens the same dialog titled esc.game.quit_confirm with Confirm esc.game.quit.

states.label: Роль: інженер
states.note: In a round only: the own role and its goal.

states.label: Роль: дисидент
states.note: A dissident also sees the team (one teammate here, Taras, as in s6 and s7); the list scrolls when it is longer than the view. With no teammates the Team column is hidden.

states.label: Звук і голос

states.label: Керування

states.label: Мова

states.label: Навчання
states.note: The tutorial's menu: only Game, Guide and Settings; Leave goes back to the main menu.

nodes.name: Dim
nodes.note: Dims the running game behind the menu.

children.name: Tabs
children.note: One ButtonGroup; the selected tab shows its page. 288 px holds the longest tab, «Налаштування», at large text, so the page never shifts between text sizes. Default tab: Lobby in the lobby, Game in a round and in the tutorial; the last tab is kept for the session. Role is hidden in the lobby; the tutorial shows only Game, Guide and Settings. Focus starts on the selected tab (drawn selected-focus); on Game, Resume takes it.

children.name: Settings
children.note: settings-controls: focus is on the capturing Interact key, so this tab is drawn selected without focus.

children.name: Title
children.note: The selected tab's name.

children.name: HostOnly
children.note: A player's view in the lobby only; hidden in a round, where nobody changes the settings and the values without steppers already read as fixed.

children.name: Locked
children.note: In a round the Character tab is locked: the same lock line as the guest's HostOnly, in the title row, so the page below does not move.

children.name: Presets
children.note: One ButtonGroup over the cards (Save is not in it). A card applies its values; any other change deselects every card (a player then reads preset.custom). Save your own stores one custom preset: a card named preset.custom, built like Standard (184 x 96, V with Name and Note), appears before Save. The row is 4 x 184 + 3 x 16 = 784 px, the width of SettingList below, so the cards end where the rows end.

children.name: Standard
children.note: The card has no text of its own: V holds the preset's name and its note (the preset's match duration); the note is ToyPresetCardNote on an idle card and ToyPresetCardNoteSelected on the selected one. 184 px holds the longest name, «Звичайний», at large text.

children.name: Note
children.note: The preset's match duration, as on every card (its name already says there are no knives).

children.name: Save
children.note: A press button with the card's raised face (not a toggle, not in the ButtonGroup): saves the current values as the own preset. Its name wraps onto two lines where it is longer than the card.

children.name: Preset
children.note: {preset} is tr() of the applied preset's name key (preset.standard, preset.quick, preset.no_knives), or preset.custom.

children.name: SettingList
children.note: The host's edits apply live for everyone. 784 px is the preset row's width, so the rows end under the last card and Side starts after the 32 px gap. Every row is at least 64 px tall (the field row's height), so the rows of a list keep one height.

children.name: Field
children.note: The lobby name (#214), lobby.default_name until the host changes it; auto_translate_mode DISABLED. editable false for a player (the quiet read-only box), who cannot scroll it, so the field shows a whole name: 500 px holds 24 characters ("Нічна зміна Мирослави №2", 447 px) at large text. max_length per #214, which has not set it yet (24 or less keeps a name whole here).

children.name: Less
children.note: Steps the value down; disabled (unplugged) at the lower bound. Keyboard and gamepad reach Less and More by focus (ui_left and ui_right move between them) and step with ui_accept. When a step reaches a bound, the other arrow takes focus (More.grab_focus()) before this one is disabled, so focus never rests on an unplugged arrow. The value is 104 px wide ("60 min" at large text), so every stepper has one width and the arrows line up down the list. Every stepper below works the same; a player sees only the value.

children.name: More
children.note: Steps the value up; disabled (unplugged) at the upper bound.

children.name: Value
children.note: str(value) (auto_translate_mode DISABLED).

children.name: Less
children.note: Disabled (unplugged): 1 is the lower bound.

children.name: Value
children.note: str(value) (auto_translate_mode DISABLED).

children.name: Value
children.note: str(value) (auto_translate_mode DISABLED).

children.name: Allowed
children.note: One toggle per task type, not grouped: selected = allowed.

children.name: Shown
children.note: A player sees allowed tasks as ToyChipLight plates and banned ones as ToyChipLineOnLight plates with ToyChipLineOnLightText.

children.name: SwitchSteps
children.note: One row per complex task type (#256), hidden while that task is banned.

children.name: Value
children.note: str(value) (auto_translate_mode DISABLED).

children.name: CodeRow
children.note: The room code, to whoever knows it: the host who hosted with a code and each player who joined with it (never an address), drawn as a keycap as on the lobby HUD (s4, the same row). Hidden for a Direct host and for Direct joiners (no code exists).

children.name: Text
children.note: The room code (auto_translate_mode DISABLED).

children.name: Copy
children.note: DisplayServer.clipboard_set(code); the text reads esc.lobby.copied for 1.5 s, then esc.lobby.copy again.

children.name: CodeGone
children.note: In place of CodeRow, only for a host who hosted with a code, when the code service closed or was never reachable; a Direct host sees neither.

children.name: Scroll
children.note: Takes the height left between the code row and Ready inside the fixed menu, so a full lobby of 10 never makes the menu taller: the rows scroll (lobby-host shows 10 players, lobby-guest 4). follow_focus = true.

children.name: Name
children.note: One row per player in join order: the own row reads player.you, the host's row lobby.host_mark with the host's name, the others the name alone (auto_translate_mode DISABLED). In the host's own view the first row is the own one. A long name is cut with an ellipsis, so it never widens the menu.

children.name: Ready
children.note: Shown while the player is ready; not ready leaves the slot empty (no dash). The marks are hidden in a round.

children.name: Ready
children.note: Toggles the own ready state: while ready it is pressed (ToyButtonPrimary's pressed look) and shows the check icon (check.svg at 24 px, tinted by ToyButtonPrimary's icon colours) before its text, the same as the own row's mark (lobby-guest: this player is ready; the page does not draw the pressed look with its icon yet). Hidden in a round, where nobody gets ready.

children.name: Preview
children.note: In the game: SubViewportContainer (stretch true) · min 380×506 with a SubViewport showing the own character; the page draws a ToyHowtoFrame placeholder.

children.name: Form
children.note: Changes apply live in the lobby. The Hat row (esc.character.hat) stays hidden until hats exist.

children.name: Field
children.note: The player's name, kept between sessions; auto_translate_mode DISABLED. editable false in a round.

children.name: Swatches
children.note: The ten body colours (#255; the palette is not decided yet).

children.name: Swatch1
children.note: In the game: TextureButton · toggle_mode · one ButtonGroup · 40×40 (focus_mode ALL in the lobby, NONE in a round; mouse_filter IGNORE in a round). The disc is tinted with the body colour (content data, #255; the page's colours are samples only).

children.name: Disc
children.note: self_modulate = the body colour (content data).

children.name: Ring
children.note: mouse_filter IGNORE.

children.name: Sel
children.note: mouse_filter IGNORE; visible while the swatch is selected.

children.name: Focus
children.note: mouse_filter IGNORE; visible while the swatch has keyboard or gamepad focus (drawn here on the third swatch).

children.name: Resume
children.note: Closes the menu (as Esc). Takes focus when the menu opens on Game.

children.name: Leave
children.note: The host: coral (ToyButtonDanger), opens the confirm dialog. A player: ToyButtonSecondary, leaves at once. In the tutorial: ToyButtonSecondary esc.game.leave_tutorial, back to the main menu (s2).

children.name: Quit
children.note: The host: opens the confirm dialog (esc.game.quit_confirm, Confirm esc.game.quit). A player, and in the tutorial: quits at once.

children.name: Role
children.note: Reads only the own role and Teammates.

children.name: Team
children.note: Dissidents only; hidden when there are no teammates.

children.name: Count
children.note: The number of teammates (here one, Taras, as in s6 and s7).

children.name: Scroll
children.note: The view is 250 px tall; the list scrolls when it is longer.

children.name: Grid
children.note: Two columns, in join order; a long list scrolls in the 250 px view.

children.name: Name
children.note: The teammate's name (auto_translate_mode DISABLED); a long name is cut with an ellipsis.

children.name: List
children.note: Fills the page height. follow_focus = true, so keyboard and gamepad focus scrolls the chip in view. 332 px holds the longest chip at large text.

children.name: V
children.note: One ButtonGroup over every chip; a chip shows its card, titled with the chip's text.

children.name: Moving
children.note: Card frames: tutorial.step.move.title, .pick_up.title, .put_down.title, .hand_belt.title.

children.name: Voice
children.note: Card frames: tutorial.step.voice.title, tutorial.step.voice.how, tutorial.list.death.

children.name: Downed
children.note: Card frames: tutorial.step.downed.title, downed.give_up_hold, tutorial.step.death.title, tutorial.step.death.how.

children.note: A spacer: 8 + 8 + 8 = 24 px between the Downed chip and the Tasks caption.

children.name: Delivery
children.note: Card frames: the pack's dist/pack/cards/delivery-1.png … delivery-4.png (the fourth is the done frame); no captions.

children.name: Switches
children.note: Only once the game has the Switches task: its card art is a sample of the card-art pages, not in the pack.

children.name: Card
children.note: P8 how-to card; a card is content data per task type (#254).

children.name: Art
children.note: The card's art: one picture per frame from the card data (#254), here the pack's Delivery PNGs dist/pack/cards/delivery-1.png … delivery-4.png (640x480, transparent). expand_mode IGNORE_SIZE, stretch_mode KEEP_ASPECT_CENTERED; 160x120 here, 320x240 in s8 and 352x264 in s3's loading card; the same card tree as s3/Card and s8/Guide/Card. The cards are wordless: a frame holds only its art, no caption.

children.name: Settings
children.note: The same subtree (one scene) as the main menu's Settings panel (s2): the mic, the mode, the threshold with its live meter, noise suppression and the volumes work without a session. Saved per player.

children.name: Sub
children.note: One ButtonGroup; Settings opens on Sound and voice.

children.name: Scroll
children.note: follow_focus = true, so keyboard and gamepad focus scrolls the focused row in view (the 15 keys of Controls, the volumes at large text).

children.name: Mic
children.note: Without the voice add-on, Mic, TalkMode, Threshold and MicTest give way to one Label(ToyTextMutedOnLight) settings.voice_unavailable.

children.name: Device
children.note: Items: settings.mic.default, then the device names (not translated). A pick opens the device under the existing "opening" mark. A long device name is cut with an ellipsis, so the row keeps its 500 px.

children.name: Mode
children.note: Voice activation (with the threshold row), push to talk (the Talk key) or off. A dropdown like Mic: three chips would not fit the main menu's Settings panel at large text.

children.name: Threshold
children.note: Shown for voice activation only.

children.name: Slider
children.note: The voice-activation threshold, 0 to 100 %.

children.name: Meter
children.note: The live mic level; it runs without a session (#301).

children.name: Toggle
children.note: One ButtonGroup: RNNoise off or on.

children.name: Slider
children.note: The Master bus, 0 to 100 %.

children.name: Slider
children.note: The voice bus, 0 to 100 %.

children.name: Slider
children.note: The effects bus, 0 to 100 %.

children.name: Slider
children.note: The music bus, 0 to 100 %.

children.name: Bind
children.note: Button(ToyKeyButton), wide (min 96): its text is the bound key's label, DisplayServer.keyboard_get_label_from_physical() of the action's binding (data, auto_translate_mode DISABLED); Space and the mouse buttons use key.space, key.mouse_left, key.mouse_right. A click or ui_accept starts capture.

children.name: Bind
children.note: Capturing: settings.controls.press_key on the pressed look; idle it shows the bound key's label (E). A click or ui_accept starts capture: set toggle_mode = true and set_pressed_no_signal(true), which draws ToyKeyButton's pressed StyleBox (it has no toggle partner), and restore both when capture ends. Capture runs in _input and calls get_viewport().set_input_as_handled() on every event, so nothing else sees it: the next key or mouse button binds, except the release of the click that started capture, which is ignored; Esc cancels and is consumed (the menu stays open); the arrows and ui_accept do not move or press focus while capturing.

children.name: Same
children.note: Only on rows whose key clashes with another action of the same phase (here Map and Talk on M); give_up and ready share F legally (different phases, #211).

children.name: ResetGap
children.note: A spacer: 4 + 12 + 4 = 20 px between the last row and Reset.

children.name: Reset
children.note: Restores the default bindings. Esc itself is fixed.

children.name: Mode
children.note: One ButtonGroup: DisplayServer window mode.

children.name: Toggle
children.note: One ButtonGroup. On swaps GameUi's theme to game_theme_large.tres live.

children.name: Toggle
children.note: One ButtonGroup; the default comes from DisplayServer.accessibility_should_reduce_animation(). On: the connecting spinner (s3) turns at half speed; the pre and post game fades (s6, s10) and the End fade are cuts; the press tween of raised buttons is instant (the pressed StyleBox still shows).

children.name: Choice
children.note: One ButtonGroup; each language is named in itself (auto_translate_mode DISABLED); the language applies at once (#208). A long list later would take ToyRadio rows.

nodes.name: ConfirmDim
nodes.note: mouse_filter STOP: blocks the mouse to the menu behind while the dialog is open. Keyboard and gamepad focus search ignores what is drawn on top, so while the dialog is open set focus_behavior_recursive = FOCUS_BEHAVIOR_DISABLED on Menu (Control, Godot 4.5+) and restore FOCUS_BEHAVIOR_INHERITED on close. The dialog handles ui_cancel itself (= Cancel) and calls get_viewport().set_input_as_handled(), so Esc closes only the dialog, not the menu too.

nodes.name: Confirm
nodes.note: P1. Opened by the host's Leave (esc.game.leave_confirm, Confirm esc.game.leave) or Quit (esc.game.quit_confirm, Confirm esc.game.quit). ui_cancel = Cancel.

children.name: ConfirmButton
children.note: Ends the session for every player and returns to the main menu (Quit: quits the game).

children.name: Cancel
children.note: Focus on open; closes the dialog.
